lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six visible vertical columns across the mid-to-posterior lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with the horizontal alignment of the circular blobs to form a grid-like pattern on the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A singular, well-defined linear feature with a vertical intensity gradient (light upper edge, shadowed lower edge) running horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank.
